01 · The squeeze

Swiggy, Zomato & Ownly find guests — then keep them.

Commission~30–35% on every plate that leaves the kitchen.
AdsPay again just to show up higher in the same feed.
DataHard to say “miss you” on WhatsApp with a personal touch.
Heart150 kitchens told us: we want our guests back.

“Easy yes from kitchens. Real yes from guests.”

02 · The real test

0% commission wins the room. Guest checkout wins the company.

  • Restaurant pain is deeply validated — that’s not the risk anymore.
  • Money on the rail comes from tiny guest fees folded into a normal bill.
  • If guests bounce to Swiggy for UI / tracking comfort, kitchens won’t stay.
  • Next chapter = live scans & paid orders — not prettier slides.

“Same board. Same butter chicken. Zero sneaky markup.”

03 · Menu promise

Restaurants don’t hike prices for YUMM. Period.

  • Dish prices stay exactly what the kitchen already sells.
  • We never ask them to inflate MRP to “cover” us.
  • Our ₹2 / item + ₹2 WhatsApp + ₹3 delivery rail are added quietly into the total — not spelled out as fee theatre.
  • Guest feels a normal food bill. Kitchen feels a normal settlement.
No fee line-items on the guest bill No “YUMM rail” on the receipt

“Little rupees. Big belonging.”

06 · Market size · TAM / SAM / SOM

Bottom-up Bangalore math — not vibes.

TAM · India food services
₹5.7L Cr

India food services market (NRAI IFSR 2024). Organized growing ~13% CAGR. YUMM sits at the Direct / owned-order wedge of this stack.

Source: NRAI IFSR 2024

SAM · Bengaluru F&B
₹26.5k Cr

Organised Bengaluru food services. ~1.1L outlets city-wide (org+unorg). ~29% already on delivery apps — Direct pain is real here.

NRAI Bengaluru · Dashmote outlet mix

SOM · Our 6 belts (near-term)
~3–5k

Addressable neighbourhood kitchens across Koramangala, BTM, HSR, Marathahalli, Jayanagar, JP Nagar (dense listing belts). Year-1 aim: 50 live → path to 500.

Belt density from public listing stats

  • Illustrative Direct volume: 50 kitchens × 40 owned orders/week ≈ 2,000 orders/week on the rail.
  • At ~₹11 YUMM / order (3 items × ₹2 + ₹2 WA + ₹3 delivery) ≈ ₹22k/week rail (~₹9.5L/yr) before Marketing/AI wallets — model, not booked revenue.
  • City signal: Bengaluru delivery is huge (aggregators ~lakhs of orders/day; ONDC has shown tens of thousands of food orders/day in BLR peaks).

Directional   Sizing uses public reports + belt density — refined after 50 live orders.
